consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1983-04-16 show at Brendan Byrne Arena was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly highlighted by the guest appearance of Stephen Stills. The setlist, including rare songs like 'Black Queen,' was well-received, and many noted the fast-paced and lively nature of the performance.
